rule: C1 Symbol identity. Every definition has exactly one ID. Every reference to it uses that ID: a call in the defining file, through an import, a re-export, an alias or a `require` binding. A definition that edges reach is listed in `nodes`, including body-less member declarations of scanned types (interface/trait/protocol methods) and module-level bindings that hold a function. A high edge's callee is always in `nodes`.
notes: store.Normalize is defined in store/cache.go and called from cache.go (same file), fill.go (same package, other file) and main.go (through the import): all three use example.com/m/store.Normalize (C1). The method Cache#Put is reached from fill.go through the parameter type *Cache and from main.go through `var c store.Cache` (decision A; a pointer names the pointee per Decisions 2026-10-29). Methods use call_type method.
